recency_ratio.label: Elapsed time since purchase / refill cycle

last_gap_ratio.label: Last refill interval / preceding product cycle

mean_gap_ratio.label: Mean refill interval / preceding product cycle

failed_since_purchase.label: Cancelled or refunded attempts since last purchase

failed_order_fraction.label: Cancelled or refunded share of recorded orders

purchases_90d.label: Completed purchases in the preceding 90 days

tenure_cycles.label: Time since first purchase / latest refill cycle

evaluation.baseline_name: Historical rate by week of remaining coverage
evaluation.threshold_policy: Maximum F1 on the separate operating-threshold cohort. Ties prefer higher precision via the higher threshold. Outreach lists use ranked capacity.

model.target: First refill-coverage lapse within 30 days among active purchasers, using the last completed product’s cycle plus 14 days of grace.
model.explanation: Each effect is the score difference when one feature is replaced by its training median. Related refill features can share information. These are model sensitivities.

forecast.method: 95% interval over independent customer outcomes conditional on these scores. Shared shocks, parameter uncertainty and domain shift are outside the interval.
